name: Editor Defaults (Archit)
description: Sets up the vault from a settings note: installs its plugins, applies the settings that differ from the defaults (Obsidian's, core plugins, hotkeys, property types, each plugin's) and writes changes made in Settings back into the note. Also: [[path]] links without the |alias, full-path heading links, YYYY-MM-DD date properties.
author: Archit
